# Data

- DAT-009: Data access follows Microsoft's EF Core efficient-querying guidance unless a measurement shows otherwise: queries project only what they need, read-only queries don't track, collections are paged in the database, related data loads without N+1 round trips and without lazy loading, and nothing is materialized before it's filtered.
- DAT-010: Raw SQL is parameterized: FromSql, SqlQuery and ExecuteSql with an interpolated string, which EF Core turns into parameters, or their Raw forms with explicit parameters; a caller's value is never concatenated or interpolated into a Raw method. Where a query needs a part that can't be a parameter, such as a column name, the code picks one of a fixed set of query texts it wrote itself, so no Raw call ever carries a caller's text; EF Core's page leaves sanitizing such a part to the developer, and the kit takes the stricter way.
